claims.text: The probability of Fletcher’s authorship is very low for the vast majority of Shakespeare’s work, with an estimated accuracy of 0.9977 when distinguishing between Shakespeare and Fletcher.
The probability that the text of H8 is a result of collaboration between Shakespeare and Fletcher is very high, with models consistently agreeing on authorship for multiple scenes.
Combined models provide a reliable discriminator between Shakespeare’s and Fletcher’s styles, yielding very high accuracy in attribution.
